library(TTR)

# 1. Membuat Fungsi Pencarian
find_optimum_sma <- function(ts_data, max_n = 12) {
  # Menyiapkan kerangka data untuk menyimpan hasil
  results <- data.frame(n = integer(), MAPE = numeric(), RMSE = numeric())
  
  # Looping untuk mencoba n dari 2 hingga batas maksimal
  for (i in 2:max_n) {
    # Proses pemulusan SMA
    sma_fit <- SMA(ts_data, n = i)
    
    # Penyesuaian lag: SMA periode ke-t adalah ramalan untuk (t+1)
    aktual <- ts_data[(i+1):length(ts_data)]
    ramalan <- sma_fit[i:(length(ts_data)-1)] 
    
    # Perhitungan Error
    error <- aktual - ramalan
    mape <- mean(abs(error / aktual), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Menyimpan hasil setiap iterasi ke dalam tabel
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(n = i, MAPE = mape, RMSE = rmse))
  }
  
  # 2. Menampilkan Tabel Evaluasi Lengkap
  cat("--- Hasil Evaluasi Akurasi Berbagai Nilai n ---\n")
  print(results)
  
  # 3. Mengekstrak n dengan MAPE terkecil
  best_n <- results$n[which.min(results$MAPE)]
  cat("\n============================================\n")
  cat("Nilai n optimum berdasarkan MAPE terkecil adalah:", best_n, "\n")
  cat("============================================\n")
  
  return(best_n)
}

# Eksekusi Fungsi pada data Anda
# max_n adalah batas maksimal periode yang ingin Anda uji (misal: 12 periode)
n_optimum <- find_optimum_sma(training_ma.ts, max_n = 12)

data.sma_optimal <- SMA(training_ma.ts, n = n_optimum)

library(forecast)

# Asumsi data awal:
# train_data : vektor data training (misal data 1:96)
# test_data  : vektor data testing (misal testing_ma.ts, data 97:120)
# n_ahead    : panjang periode testing (misal 24 periode)

cari_m_optimum_dma <- function(train_data, test_data, m_range = 2:8) {
  hasil_list <- list()
  n_test <- length(test_data)
  
  for (m in m_range) {
    n_train <- length(train_data)
    
    # 1. Single Moving Average
    sma <- stats::filter(train_data, rep(1/m, m), sides = 1)
    
    # 2. Double Moving Average (DMA)
    dma <- stats::filter(sma, rep(1/m, m), sides = 1)
    
    # Ambil nilai terakhir yang valid dari training
    At_last <- (2 * sma[n_train]) - dma[n_train]
    Bt_last <- (2 / (m - 1)) * (sma[n_train] - dma[n_train])
    
    # 3. Peramalan n-langkah ke depan (out-of-sample forecast untuk data testing)
    p <- 1:n_test
    forecast_test <- At_last + (Bt_last * p)
    
    # 4. Hitung Error terhadap data testing
    error_test <- test_data - forecast_test
    
    sse  <- sum(error_test^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    mse  <- mean(error_test^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    rmse <- sqrt(mse)
    mape <- mean(abs(error_test / test_data) * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    hasil_list[[as.character(m)]] <- c(m = m, SSE = sse, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAPE = mape)
  }
  
  # Gabungkan hasil ke dalam dataframe
  tabel_evaluasi <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, hasil_list))
  rownames(tabel_evaluasi) <- NULL
  
  # Urutkan berdasarkan MAPE terkecil
  tabel_evaluasi <- tabel_evaluasi[order(tabel_evaluasi$MAPE), ]
  
  # m terbaik
  m_optimum <- tabel_evaluasi$m[1]
  
  cat("=========================================\n")
  cat("Ringkasan Evaluasi Seluruh Nilai m:\n")
  cat("=========================================\n")
  print(tabel_evaluasi)
  cat("-----------------------------------------\n")
  cat(paste0(">>> Nilai m Optimum (MAPE Terkecil): m = ", m_optimum, 
             " (MAPE: ", round(tabel_evaluasi$MAPE[1], 4), "%)\n"))
  
  return(list(tabel = tabel_evaluasi, m_opt = m_optimum))
}
m_optimum_result <- cari_m_optimum_dma(training_ma.ts, testing_ma.ts, m_range = 2:8)

## Akurasi Data Latih

error_train.dma = training_ma.ts-data.ramal2[1:length(training_ma.ts)]

SSE_train.dma = sum(error_train.dma[8:length(training_ma.ts)]^2)
MSE_train.dma = mean(error_train.dma[8:length(training_ma.ts)]^2)
MAPE_train.dma = mean(abs((error_train.dma[8:length(training_ma.ts)]/training_ma.ts[8:length(training_ma.ts)])*100))

akurasi_train.dma <- matrix(c(SSE_train.dma, MSE_train.dma, MAPE_train.dma))
row.names(akurasi_train.dma)<- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_train.dma) <- c("Akurasi m = 2")
akurasi_train.dma
##      Akurasi m = 2
## SSE    68.64385615
## MSE     0.04150173
## MAPE           Inf

Akurasi data uji

error_test.dma = testing_ma.ts-data.gab2[97:120,6]
## Warning in `-.default`(testing_ma.ts, data.gab2[97:120, 6]): longer object
## length is not a multiple of shorter object length
SSE_test.dma = sum(error_test.dma^2)
MSE_test.dma = mean(error_test.dma^2)
MAPE_test.dma = mean(abs((error_test.dma/testing_ma.ts*100)))

akurasi_test.dma <- matrix(c(SSE_test.dma, MSE_test.dma, MAPE_test.dma))
row.names(akurasi_test.dma)<- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_test.dma) <- c("Akurasi m = 2")
akurasi_test.dma
##      Akurasi m = 2
## SSE    388.2459756
## MSE      0.9332836
## MAPE   143.7913500

Exponential smoothing

Pembagian data

# Gunakan data_mpdw yang sudah ada
n <- nrow(data_mpdw)

# hitung batas 80%
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)

# bagi data
training <- data_mpdw[1:n_train, ]
testing  <- data_mpdw[(n_train+1):n, ]

# ubah ke time series menggunakan kolom yang benar
train.ts <- ts(training$`Monthly Anomaly`)
test.ts  <- ts(testing$`Monthly Anomaly`)

Eksplorasi

plot(data_mpdw.ts, col="black",main="Plot semua data")
points(data_mpdw.ts)

plot(train.ts, col="red",main="Plot data latih")
points(train.ts)

plot(test.ts, col="blue",main="Plot data uji")
points(test.ts)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot() + 
  # Ganti Periode menjadi Year, dan Yt menjadi `Monthly Anomaly`
  geom_line(data = training, aes(x = Year, y = `Monthly Anomaly`, col = "Data Latih")) +
  geom_line(data = testing, aes(x = Year, y = `Monthly Anomaly`, col = "Data Uji")) +
  # Sesuaikan juga label x dan y agar sesuai dengan data Anda
  labs(x = "Tahun", y = "Monthly Anomaly", color = "Legend") +
  scale_colour_manual(name="Keterangan:", breaks = c("Data Latih", "Data Uji"),
                      values = c("blue", "red")) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                     plot.caption = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=12))

Single Exponential Smoothing

Seasonal Smoothing

#Import data
library(rio)
## Warning: package 'rio' was built under R version 4.5.3
data3 <- import("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rizkynurhambali/praktikum-sta1341/main/Pertemuan%201/Electric_Production.csv")
data3.ts <- ts(data3$Yt)
#membagi data menjadi training dan testing
training<-data3[1:192,2]
testing<-data3[193:241,2]
training.ts<-ts(training, frequency = 13)

Peramalan

#Forecast
forecast1 <- predict(winter1, n.ahead = 49)
forecast1.opt <- predict(winter1.opt, n.ahead = 49)

Plot Deret Waktu

#Plot time series
plot(training.ts,main="Winter 0.2;0.1;0.1",type="l",col="black",
     xlim=c(1,25),pch=12)
lines(xhat1,type="l",col="red")
lines(xhat1.opt,type="l",col="blue")
lines(forecast1,type="l",col="red")
lines(forecast1.opt,type="l",col="blue")
legend("topleft",c("Actual Data",expression(paste(winter1)),
                   expression(paste(winter1.opt))),cex=0.5,
       col=c("black","red","blue"),lty=1)

Akurasi Data Latih

#Akurasi data training
SSE1<-winter1$SSE
MSE1<-winter1$SSE/length(training.ts)
RMSE1<-sqrt(MSE1)
akurasi1 <- matrix(c(SSE1,MSE1,RMSE1))
row.names(akurasi1)<- c("SSE", "MSE", "RMSE")
colnames(akurasi1) <- c("Akurasi")
akurasi1
##          Akurasi
## SSE  19249.76741
## MSE    100.25921
## RMSE    10.01295
SSE1.opt<-winter1.opt$SSE
MSE1.opt<-winter1.opt$SSE/length(training.ts)
RMSE1.opt<-sqrt(MSE1.opt)
akurasi1.opt <- matrix(c(SSE1.opt,MSE1.opt,RMSE1.opt))
row.names(akurasi1.opt)<- c("SSE1.opt", "MSE1.opt", "RMSE1.opt")
colnames(akurasi1.opt) <- c("Akurasi")
akurasi1.opt
##                Akurasi
## SSE1.opt  13896.693461
## MSE1.opt     72.378612
## RMSE1.opt     8.507562
akurasi1.train = data.frame(Model_Winter = c("Winter 1","Winter1 optimal"),
                            Nilai_SSE=c(SSE1,SSE1.opt),
                            Nilai_MSE=c(MSE1,MSE1.opt),Nilai_RMSE=c(RMSE1,RMSE1.opt))
akurasi1.train
##      Model_Winter Nilai_SSE Nilai_MSE Nilai_RMSE
## 1        Winter 1  19249.77 100.25921  10.012952
## 2 Winter1 optimal  13896.69  72.37861   8.507562

AKuras Data Uji

#Akurasi Data Testing
forecast1<-data.frame(forecast1)
testing.ts<-data.frame(testing.ts)
selisih1<-forecast1-testing.ts
SSEtesting1<-sum(selisih1^2)
MSEtesting1<-SSEtesting1/length(testing.ts)

forecast1.opt<-data.frame(forecast1.opt)
selisih1.opt<-forecast1.opt-testing.ts
SSEtesting1.opt<-sum(selisih1.opt^2)
MSEtesting1.opt<-SSEtesting1.opt/length(testing.ts)
akurasi_testing <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Model1", "Model Optimum"),
  SSE   = c(SSEtesting1, SSEtesting1.opt),
  MSE   = c(MSEtesting1, MSEtesting1.opt)
)

akurasi_testing
##           Model       SSE       MSE
## 1        Model1  6589.276  6589.276
## 2 Model Optimum 11578.072 11578.072

#Akurasi data training

RMSE2<-sqrt(MSE2)
akurasi1 <- matrix(c(SSE2,MSE2,RMSE2))
row.names(akurasi1)<- c("SSE2", "MSE2", "RMSE2")
colnames(akurasi1) <- c("Akurasi lamda=0.2")
akurasi1

row.names(akurasi1.opt)<- c("SSE2.opt", "MSE2.opt", "RMSE2.opt")

Akurasi Data Uji

#Akurasi Data Testing
forecast2<-data.frame(forecast2)
testing.ts<-data.frame(testing.ts)
selisih2<-forecast2-testing.ts
SSEtesting2<-sum(selisih2^2)
MSEtesting2<-SSEtesting2/length(testing.ts)

forecast2.opt<-data.frame(forecast2.opt)
selisih2.opt<-forecast2.opt-testing.ts
SSEtesting2.opt<-sum(selisih2.opt^2)
MSEtesting2.opt<-SSEtesting2.opt/length(testing.ts)
# Atau rapikan dalam tabel
akurasi_testing2 <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Model2", "Model2 Optimal"),
  SSE   = c(SSEtesting2, SSEtesting2.opt),
  MSE   = c(MSEtesting2, MSEtesting2.opt)
)
